title: Senate hearing on National Security Space Launch Programs with Elon Musk
summary: Video of the March 2014 Senate Defense Subcommittee hearing on National Security Space Launch programs. Elon Musk of SpaceX testifies alongside ULA's CEO, a GAO official and a policy expert, on launch contracts and Russian engines.
why: HN points to it as an entertaining and informative look at the SpaceX versus ULA rivalry.

quote.text: I watched a senate hearing where Elon Musk squares off with the ULA. It's awesome.
